entities.summary: The Sōbu Main Line  is a Japanese railway line operated by the East Japan Railway Company in Japan. It connects Tokyo with the east coast of Chiba Prefecture, passing through the cities of Funabashi, Chiba, and Chōshi. Its name derives from the old provinces of the area which it serves: Musashi, Shimōsa and Kazusa. Its official line color is navy.
